subject: proj-dy
title: PROJ.DY.------PRIN.INFO.
description: Diagram in WAM-32, the page where Braxton names the post-Webern/post-Cage juncture as 'the dissolution of the composite vibrational alignment of western culture', having read serial music on the preceding page as connected simultaneously to the western source-initiation thrust *and* to the source-transfer junction of world creativity. (C)PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is crossed with PRI-INFO (principle information; title abbreviates as PRIN.INFO): the diagram poses that under post-Cageian conditions, projectional dynamics have to be re-grounded by re-engaging principle information — but the routes are constrained. Besides the main line to PRI-INFO, PROJ-DY branches three ways: into AFL-DY (affinity dynamics); into AFL-DT (affinity dictates) → RE-ST (restructuralism) → ALT-F (alternative functionalism) → PART (participation); and into INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → POL-DYM (political dynamics).
